f3_program: collection("mary.story.characters", "character", "mary.story", source("her 60 characters"))
observe(at("mary.story.characters.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("60 characters"))
collection("mary.story.characters.by_initial", "character_group", "mary.story", source("split according to their initials"))
member("mary.story.characters.by_initial", "mary.story.characters.initial_a", source("Half of her characters have the initial A"))
member("mary.story.characters.by_initial", "mary.story.characters.initial_c", source("half of this amount have the initial C"))
member("mary.story.characters.by_initial", "mary.story.characters.initial_d", source("the rest of her characters to have the initials D and E"))
member("mary.story.characters.by_initial", "mary.story.characters.initial_e", source("the rest of her characters to have the initials D and E"))
partition("mary.story.characters.by_initial", at("mary.story.characters.count", "current"), source("her 60 characters to be split according to their initials"))
fraction_of(at("mary.story.characters.initial_a.count", "current"), at("mary.story.characters.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Half of her characters have the initial A"))
fraction_of(at("mary.story.characters.initial_c.count", "current"), at("mary.story.characters.initial_a.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("half of this amount have the initial C"))

multiple(at("mary.story.characters.initial_d.count", "current"), at("mary.story.characters.initial_e.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many characters with the initial D as there are characters with the initial E"))
query("value", at("mary.story.characters.initial_d.count", "current"))
collection("polar_bear_club.cold_water_durations", "duration", "swimming_pool", source("Jerry was in the pool for 3 minutes"))
member("polar_bear_club.cold_water_durations", "polar_bear_club.jerry.cold_water.duration", source("Jerry was in the pool for 3 minutes"))
member("polar_bear_club.cold_water_durations", "polar_bear_club.elaine.cold_water.duration", source("Elaine stayed in the pool for twice as long as Jerry"))
member("polar_bear_club.cold_water_durations", "polar_bear_club.george.cold_water.duration", source("George could only stay in the pool for one-third as long as Elaine"))
observe(at("polar_bear_club.jerry.cold_water.duration", "pool_visit"), 3, "minute", source("Jerry was in the pool for 3 minutes"))

multiple(at("polar_bear_club.elaine.cold_water.duration", "pool_visit"), at("polar_bear_club.jerry.cold_water.duration", "pool_visit"), 2, source("Elaine stayed in the pool for twice as long as Jerry"))

fraction_of(at("polar_bear_club.george.cold_water.duration", "pool_visit"), at("polar_bear_club.elaine.cold_water.duration", "pool_visit"), 1, 3, source("George could only stay in the pool for one-third as long as Elaine"))
query("sum", "polar_bear_club.cold_water_durations", "pool_visit")
assumptions: The queried duration collection contains only the people stated to have spent time in the pool; Kramer has no duration member because he could not find the pool.

f3_program: collection("pete.books_read.yearly_counts", "book_count", "pete", source("Pete read twice as many books as Matt did last year, and this year he doubles that number"))
member("pete.books_read.yearly_counts", at("pete.books_read.count", "last_year"), source("Pete read twice as many books as Matt did last year"))
member("pete.books_read.yearly_counts", at("pete.books_read.count", "this_year"), source("this year he doubles that number"))
multiple(at("pete.books_read.count", "last_year"), at("matt.books_read.count", "last_year"), 2, source("Pete read twice as many books as Matt did last year"))
multiple(at("pete.books_read.count", "this_year"), at("pete.books_read.count", "last_year"), 2, source("this year he doubles that number"))
percent_more(at("matt.books_read.count", "this_year"), at("matt.books_read.count", "last_year"), 50, source("this year he doubles that number while Matt reads only 50% more"))
observe(at("matt.books_read.count", "this_year"), 75, "count", source("Matt read 75 books in his second year"))
query("sum", "pete.books_read.yearly_counts", "both_years")
assumptions: “his second year” refers to Matt’s this-year value in the two-year comparison.

f3_program: observe(at("marianne.age", "when_bella_was_8"), 20, "year", source("Marianne was 20 years old when Bella was 8 years old"))
observe(at("bella.age", "when_bella_was_8"), 8, "year", source("Bella was 8 years old"))
observe(at("bella.age", "when_bella_turns_18"), 18, "year", source("Bella turns 18"))
query("value", at("marianne.age", "when_bella_turns_18"))

assumptions: The requested hour value requires the unstated conversion between a day and hours, which F3-v1 does not allow the annotation to invent.
